files.role: Modify existing router: replace SQL-based fetch_labels_for_tasks with HTTP batch call; transform search_labels and get_task_labels to return Dataset

modifications.description: Remove conn parameter and SQL implementation. New signature: fetch_labels_for_tasks(task_ids: list[str]) -> dict[str, list[dict]]. Body: if not task_ids, return {}. Use _label_client() to POST /api/objects/labels/batch with json={'object_ids': task_ids, 'object_type': 'task'}. If resp.status_code != 200, return {}. Return resp.json().get('labels', {}).
Change fetch_labels_for_tasks(conn, task_ids) to fetch_labels_for_tasks(task_ids). Remove conn argument.

After fetching from LabelEngine GET /api/labels, extract items = resp.json().get('labels', []). If resp.status_code != 200, return JSONResponse(status_code=resp.status_code, content=resp.json()). Return dataset_response(Dataset(meta=DatasetMeta(object_type='label', label='Labels', total=len(items), page=1, page_size=len(items), row_actions=[]), **{'schema': [ColumnSchema(key='id', label='ID', type='string'), ColumnSchema(key='name', label='Name', type='string')]}, rows=[{'id': item['id'], 'name': item['name']} for item in items])).

After fetching from LabelEngine GET /api/objects/{task_id}/labels, extract items = resp.json().get('labels', []). If resp.status_code != 200, return JSONResponse(status_code=resp.status_code, content=resp.json()). Return dataset_response(Dataset(meta=DatasetMeta(object_type='task_label', label='Task Labels', total=len(items), page=1, page_size=len(items), row_actions=['delete']), **{'schema': [ColumnSchema(key='id', label='ID', type='string'), ColumnSchema(key='name', label='Name', type='string'), ColumnSchema(key='attached_at', label='Attached', type='date')]}, rows=[{'id': lbl['label_id'], 'name': lbl['label_name'], 'attached_at': lbl['attached_at']} for lbl in items])).

methods.name: fetch_labels_for_tasks
methods.purpose: Call LabelEngine batch endpoint; return map of task_id to label records; return {} on empty input or error

methods.name: search_labels
methods.purpose: Proxy label search to LabelEngine; return Dataset with id and name columns

methods.name: get_task_labels
methods.purpose: Proxy task label fetch to LabelEngine; return Dataset with id, name, attached_at columns

files.role: Modify existing frontend: update three call sites that consume bespoke label shapes to consume Dataset res.rows instead

modifications.description: Change apiFetch<{ labels: LabelRecord[] }>(`/tasks/labels/search?q=...`) and (res as { labels: LabelRecord[] }).labels to: apiFetch<{ rows: { id: string; name: string }[] }>(`/tasks/labels/search?q=...`) and setSuggestions(res.rows.map(r => ({ id: r.id as string, name: r.name as string })) ?? [])
Same transformation as LabelPanel search call site: consume res.rows with id and name mapping.

Change apiFetch<{ labels: AttachedLabel[] }>(`/tasks/${task.id}/labels`) and (res as { labels: AttachedLabel[] }).labels to: apiFetch<{ rows: { id: string; name: string; attached_at: string }[] }>(`/tasks/${task.id}/labels`) and setAttachedLabels(res.rows.map(r => ({ label_id: r.id as string, label_name: r.name as string, attached_at: r.attached_at as string })) ?? [])

Change apiFetch<{ labels: LabelRecord[] }>(`/tasks/labels/search?q=...`) and (res as { labels: LabelRecord[] }).labels to: apiFetch<{ rows: { id: string; name: string }[] }>(`/tasks/labels/search?q=...`) and setLabelSugs(res.rows.map(r => ({ id: r.id as string, name: r.name as string })) ?? []). This is the handleLabelQueryChange function inside TaskCreatePanel.
